name: Page/Post Converter for WPBakery to Elementor
author: sflwa

sections.description:
This plugin will enable the user to select a page to clone and convert WPBakery Shortcodes to Elementor Widgets

Requirements / Suggestions

  • Free Version of Elementor
  • WP Bakery is NOT required to run this plugin, but is helpful to see the current layout
  • Various Elementor add-ons (Free or Paid) to replicate functionality of custom add-ons from WP Bakery

Instructions

  1. Install & Activate the plugin.
  2. Located under tools goto WPB2E Page Converter.
  3. Select the page you wish to convert and click the convert button.
  4. Edit your Elementor page for additional widgets & styles

Converted Tags

  • vc_row -> Elementor Container
  • vc_column_text -> Elementor Text Area
  • vc_single_image -> Elementor Image
  • slider_rev -> Slider Revolution Elementor Widget

Important Information

This plugin will NOT do a 100% conversion. You will need to adjust styles and set up nested containers where needed. It is designed to help speed up the conversation process and reduce the amount of copy and paste.
The goal of the plugin is to use core (Free) widgets where possible followed by Pro and then 3rd party.

Future Features

  • Posts, Custom Post Types
  • Bulk Select Pages
  • Customize Shortcode to Widget Mapping
